agenda_text:
COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Tim Hepburn, Mayor
Wendy Lau, Council Member  Rick Crosby, Council Member
Steven Frank Johnson, Council Member  Meshal "Kash" Kashifalghita, Mayor Pro Tem

  Saturday, May 17, 2025
  Strategic Planning Meeting at 9:00 AM
  La Verne City Hall - Council Chambers,
  3660 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at
(909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Individuals can email their comments to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org no later
than noon on Friday, May 16. Those comments will be shared with City Council in advance of the City
Council meeting and included as part of the permanent record. Please be advised that public
comments submitted by emails or any other format to the City are public records that will be
made available for public viewing.

Individuals who wish to share their comments with Council during the meeting may do so in a variety
of ways:

1. Attend the Special Meeting in person and fill out a comment card.
2. Public comment shall be limited to only those items described on this Special Meeting
  Notice/Agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3(a)).
3. Public Comments are limited to three (3) minutes per speaker unless a different time limit is
  announced. It is requested that you state your name for the record, then proceed to address the
  City Council.

Council Meeting Decorum: Per the City’s Rules for Decorum, all Speakers and Members of the
Audience are to conduct themselves with decorum and not engage in willful conduct which interrupts
the meeting or with the orderly conduct of the meeting.

REMINDER: Please silence all electronic devices while City Council is in session.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to Section 54956 of the California Government Code,
that a Special Meeting of the La Verne City Council is hereby called for the following purpose:

  9:00 AM STRATEGIC PLANNING SESSION

CALL TO ORDER
 AGENDA  City Council-Special Meeting Strategic Planning 5/17/2025  Page 2

ROLL CALL  Council Member Wendy Lau, Council Member Steven Johnson, Council
  Member Rick Crosby, Mayor Pro Tem Meshal "Kash" Kashifalghita, and
  Mayor Tim Hepburn.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

STRATEGIC PLAN DISUSSION AND UPDATE. The City Council will participate in an externally
facilitated Strategic Planning and Priority Setting Workshop to develop a comprehensive plan that
guides the City's future direction, ensuring its long-term success, prioritization of services, fiscal
sustainability, and alignment with community needs. This workshop includes defining the City's
vision, mission, and values, discussing specific goals and objectives, and developing strategies to
achieve those goals which will be brought back for City Council consideration at a future regular City
Council meeting.

A general outline of major topic areas includes (tentative based on timing):

Welcome/Introductions - 9:00 am
  Session I- Financial Overview (9:30 am)
  Session II- Strategic Planning Overview (10:15 am)
  Session III- SWOT Activity (11:00 am)
Break - 11:30 am
  Session IV- Mission Statement Work (11:45 am)
Lunch Break/Gallery Walk - 12:30 pm
  Session V- Values (1:30 pm)
  Session VI- Strategic Priorities (2:00 pm)
  Next Steps (3:00 pm)
  Public Comment (3:15 pm)
  Wrap-Up/Reflections (3:30 pm)
Conclude - 4:00 pm

 ADJOURMENT

  THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE LA VERNE CITY COUNCIL IS
  SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, MAY 19, 2025, at 5:30 P.M.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on May 14, 2025, on the bulletin
board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.cityoflaverne.org.
